newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes unmoved in dull trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed virtually unmoved against the dollar in dull Tuesday trade, which saw little commercial demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.44 to the dollar after opening at 58.45. On Monday, it closed at 58.46.
"The market was very dull. There was no commercial demand and no speculative activity," said a Commercial Bank dealer.
Dealers said demand for the dollar has slipped steadily over the past few days.

"The money market tends to believe that exchange rates and interest rates will be kept low in the near future. So tendency for the dollar to go up is much less in this market," the Commercial Bank dealer said.
Overnight call money, which opened at 11 percent, closed at 9.5 percent with the market liquid, dealers said.
